name: aveon-sigorta
description: Insurance in North Cyprus. Browse Aveon Sigorta's insurance products and ask Aveon to call you back with a quote.

interface.longDescription:
Aveon Sigorta is a licensed insurance company in the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus (KKTC / TRNC). With this plugin you can see Aveon's 17 insurance products (traffic, kasko, home, health, travel health, workplace, cyber, construction, professional liability and more) and send a quote request so an Aveon agent calls you back.

The plugin only registers a callback request after you review and confirm the details you share (name, mobile number, product, and optionally email, coverage amount and a short note). It does not calculate prices, issue policies or handle claims. For claims, call Aveon's 24/7 claims line; compulsory traffic policies can also be bought online at police.aveoninsurance.com.
defaultPrompt: What insurance products does Aveon offer in North Cyprus?
I need kasko for my car in Lefkoşa, can Aveon call me?
Get me a home insurance quote from Aveon Sigorta.

positive.prompt: What insurance products does Aveon Sigorta offer in North Cyprus?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Aveon's product list (e.g. traffic, kasko, home, health, travel health, workplace) with short descriptions, without inventing prices.

positive.description: Request a kasko quote callback after confirmation
positive.prompt: I want kasko for my 2021 Toyota Corolla. My name is Test User, phone +905331234567. Please have Aveon call me.
positive.expected_behavior: Maps the request to product_kasko, shows the details to be sent, asks for explicit confirmation, then calls request-quote with the vehicle in the message and tells the user an agent will call back. No price is quoted.

positive.description: Home insurance quote with coverage amount and currency
positive.prompt: Can Aveon quote home insurance for my flat in Girne, about 150,000 GBP cover? I'm Test User, +905331234567, test@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses product_home, coverage_limit 150000 and coverage_currency GBP, confirms details with the user before calling request-quote, then confirms the callback request was registered.

positive.description: Collect missing phone number before sending
positive.prompt: I'd like travel health insurance from Aveon for a trip next month.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies product_travel, asks for the user's name and mobile number in international format, shows the summary, and only calls request-quote after the user confirms.

positive.description: Workplace insurance request for a shop
positive.prompt: I need workplace insurance for my shop in Nicosia. My name is Test User, phone +905331234567.
positive.expected_behavior: Maps the request to product_fire (Workplace Insurance), shows the details and asks for confirmation, then calls request-quote and says an Aveon agent will call back.

negative.prompt: How much exactly will Aveon charge me for kasko on my car?

negative.description: Asks to file an insurance claim
negative.prompt: I had an accident today, file a claim with Aveon for me.
Get me car insurance in London from Aveon.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell policies or process payments. It only registers a callback request for an Aveon agent.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list Aveon Sigorta insurance products and request a quote callback.

tr-TR.subtitle: Kuzey Kıbrıs'ta sigorta
tr-TR.description:
Aveon Sigorta, Kuzey Kıbrıs Türk Cumhuriyeti'nde (KKTC) lisanslı bir sigorta şirketidir. Bu eklentiyle Aveon'un 17 sigorta ürününü (trafik, kasko, konut, sağlık, seyahat sağlık, işyeri, siber güvenlik, inşaat, mesleki sorumluluk ve daha fazlası) görebilir ve bir Aveon temsilcisinin sizi araması için teklif talebi gönderebilirsiniz.

Eklenti, paylaştığınız bilgileri (ad, cep telefonu, ürün ve isteğe bağlı olarak e-posta, teminat tutarı ve kısa not) gözden geçirip onayladıktan sonra yalnızca geri arama talebi kaydeder. Fiyat hesaplamaz, poliçe düzenlemez ve hasar işlemi yapmaz. Hasar için Aveon'un 7/24 hasar hattını arayın; zorunlu trafik poliçesini police.aveoninsurance.com üzerinden online da alabilirsiniz.
